evidenceReport.title: Candidate evidence report
evidenceReport.description: Your download includes the full CV and job text, reviewed requirements, and edit-source records. Check the file contents before sharing.
evidenceReport.historical: The saved assessment uses an earlier CV or job description. Refresh it to review evidence for the current version.
evidenceReport.includeClarification: Include this private answer as a source
evidenceReport.requirementsHelp: Review these suggested requirements and CV passages. Confirm a passage or leave a gap to include the requirement in your report.
evidenceReport.changed: Inputs or inclusion choices changed. Prepare and review a new report before downloading.
evidenceReport.failed: The report could not be prepared or downloaded. Try again.
evidenceReport.question: What should I improve for this role?
evidenceReport.invalid: Choose exact text from the posting and source.
evidenceReport.draftHelp: This prepares an editable CV draft. Review it in the CV tab before saving a new version.
evidenceReport.ambiguous: This passage appears more than once or has changed. Edit it directly in your CV.
evidenceReport.existingDraft: You already have an unsaved draft in the CV tab. Finish it before preparing another.
evidenceReport.draftFailed: Could not save the draft. Keep a copy of your text and try again.
evidenceReport.noReviewed: No requirements have been reviewed yet.
